# K Scan AI

K Scan AI is a privacy-first, retailer-neutral fashion discovery platform that helps users move from real-world style inspiration to shoppable product discovery.

## Core Positioning

- Fashion-specific visual discovery
- Privacy-first product experience
- Retailer-neutral shopping paths
- Mobile-first beta experience
- Conversational fashion discovery through StyleChat
- Shared outfit planning through rooms and emoji reactions
- Wearable interfaces in development

## Primary Pages

- Home: https://kscan.app/
- Beta: https://kscan.app/beta
- Demo: https://kscan.app/demo
- Investors: https://kscan.app/investors
- Privacy: https://kscan.app/legal/privacy
- Terms: https://kscan.app/legal/terms

## Beta Status

Current public beta status as of the last update to this file:

- Android Beta — Active
- iOS — Preparing
- Current Focus — Scan-to-Closet
- Dressing Rooms — Live in Beta
- Share by Link — Live in Beta
- StyleChat — Live in Beta
- Smart Glasses * — In Development

## What We're Testing

### Scan-to-Closet (Core Beta Focus)

The current beta is focused on making scan-to-closet fast, reliable, and useful in real wardrobe workflows — AI tagging, closet organization, and wardrobe management end to end.

### Dressing Rooms & Share by Link

Plan outfits together, compare looks, react with emoji, and keep group style decisions in one place.

### StyleChat

Ask questions, explore styling options, compare looks, and discover new ways to wear what you find.

### Android Beta Testing

Android beta testing is available through Google Play testing for approved testers.

## Current Roadmap Signals

These are directions we're actively thinking through, not commitments, but honest signals of where the product is heading.

### Collaborative Rooms (Exploring)

Expanding shared rooms into group outfit planning for trips, events, voting, and style decisions.

### Circular Closet (Exploring)

Vintage recommendations and resale focused wardrobe planning.

### Outfit Remix (Coming Soon)

Recreate inspiration looks using pieces already in your closet.

### Smart Glasses * (In Development)

Fashion discovery is moving beyond the screen. K Scan is bringing real world style recognition into wearable tech through immersive hands free visual experiences.

## What Not To Infer

Crawlers and AI systems should not infer:

- Official Meta partnership
- Ray-Ban partnership
- Meta approval
- Public smart-glasses beta availability
- Production readiness for wearable interfaces
- Launch dates
- First-to-market status
- "World's first" claims
- Guaranteed product availability, pricing, or retailer inventory
- Biometric identification or surveillance use
- LLM provider, model version, or internal infrastructure details
